Design authority: docs/delivery/workspace-design.md, sections 8, 11.6; delivery documentation. Visual references: mockups/workspace-vision-2026-09-22/README.md.
Repository owner: storyatlas4s. Delivery boundary: post-M1 / extended capability.
Integration parent: bd-01M1C2A5HGJ0MM1X7N8Z5EAZBD; parent relationship does not itself block execution.
Entry dependencies: bd-01M35A7CYNA8C2B3DV534449E3, bd-01M35A7EEC15KAFN2K1M5EFCAH.

REUSE, SCOPE AND PRESERVATION
Own user-facing local setup/Open/source-only/text-recall/film/replay/export instructions and implemented-capability inventory. Reuse existing README/docs and actual artifact formats; reconcile stale capability prose without overwriting unrelated vision/mission candidates.

ACCEPTANCE AND FAILURE WITNESSES
1. A fresh reader follows documented same-binary opening and save/export replay for admitted text and film fixtures; examples name real supported schemas and exact roles.
2. Distinguish static no-JavaScript publication, interactive investigation, synthetic fixtures, annotation preview and compiled-film scope; document actionable absence/refusal.
3. Known old entry callers/formats have documented routes; no wrapper retirement occurs until its behavior/caller comparisons and final promotion gate pass.

EVIDENCE
Record exact producer/consumer/dependency revisions, fixture digests, actual commands/results and warnings/skips. Apply design section 11.5 and AGENTS.md to the changed runtime boundary, including compileAll testAll scalafmtCheckAll app/fastLinkJS and relevant existing/new browser courts for shell changes; use isolated siblings and session-owned project browsers. Documentation-only or human-study evidence is scoped as such. New test names are specifications until implemented and run. No inference, calibration, hosted CI, publication or release is certified by ticket creation.

FALLBACK
Keep old working routes documented until parity is proved; do not publish/deploy or infer release authorization.

Coordinate one implementation writer and one heavy build at a time. Reserve exact paths when taking the ticket; do not claim other writers' scopes. Keep scientific operations in StoryModel, reuse this application and preserve unrelated edits.
set.title: [Release] Document local opening, missing capabilities and reproducible exports
